description: A streaming event producer must give final approval for an interactive fan-voting finale during a live awards stream and lock the voting rules, channel, capacity, and moderation plan.

shared_context.S1: The awards stream is scheduled for Saturday at 8:00 PM and includes a proposed live fan-voting finale.
shared_context.S2: Mara gives the binding final approval for the finale plan.
shared_context.S3: The audience technology team estimates that as many as 15,000 remote viewers may try to participate.
shared_context.S4: At the final greenlight meeting, the broadcast standards producer and audience technology lead must each use the formal reveal action to record their confirmed requirements and current provisions before Mara locks the plan using those constraints; no additional vendor response or document-entry step is required before approval.

PF1.text: Devon confirmed in the broadcaster's standards memo that the vote may run only with an under-18 exclusion and must close at exactly 9:40 PM so the result can be reviewed before the closing credits; these confirmed requirements are ready to be adopted directly into the final plan.

PF2.text: Riley confirmed with the voting vendor that Saturday's provisioned service supports web voting reached through an on-screen QR code, not SMS voting, and is capped at exactly 12,000 eligible voters; these current provisions are sufficient to set the final channel and cap, with audience messaging covering the limit.

acceptance_conditions: The fan vote must be enabled under a compliant operating plan.
Voting must close at exactly 9:40 PM.
The plan must cap eligible voters at exactly 12,000.
Voting must use web voting reached through an on-screen QR code.
The final plan must record an age-gate commitment.
The final plan must record a QR web-voting commitment.

content_checks.C3: decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and older only' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and over only' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == 'under-18 exclusion' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and over only (under-18 exclusion)'
content_checks.C5: decisions['voting_channel'] == 'web via on-screen QR code' or decisions['voting_channel'] == 'web voting via on-screen QR code' or decisions['voting_channel'] == 'Web voting via on-screen QR code'
content_checks.C6: any('under-18' in c.get('detail', '') or 'age' in c.get('type', '') or 'standards' in c.get('type', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('QR' in c.get('detail', '') or 'qr' in c.get('detail', '') or 'qr' in c.get('type', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The standards memo changes the vote close to exactly 9:40 PM, changes eligibility to an under-18 exclusion, and supplies the basis for the age-gate commitment.
The vendor confirmation changes the channel to web voting via an on-screen QR code, fixes the eligible-voter cap at exactly 12,000, and supplies the basis for the QR web-voting commitment.
